question: Why does your voice sound different when you hear a recording?
topic: Why Your Recorded Voice Sounds Different
why_curious: Almost everyone has heard a recording of their own voice and thought it sounded strangely different. The answer reveals how your brain normally hears you and why a recording exposes a version other people hear.
curiosity_gap: You expect a recording to reproduce the voice you hear while speaking, but your brain normally hears your voice through more than one path.
search_angles: vocal tract resonance and perceived pitch
why other people hear a different version of your voice
